reviews.title: What happened ? keyboard doesn’t work right on iPad
reviews.text:
I’ve been using this planner for years. Love it!

Today the keyboard only on this App doesn’t work on iPad (9th generation). It still works on my phone, but the when trying to type in appointments on the iPad, the keyboard keys type the wrong numbers and characters randomly.

So I can’t use it, which is a great disappointment. 
I really wish you would fix this bug.
Thank you.

reviews.title: Why can I not just write on it!
reviews.text: Why pay for something that I already have in my iPad, I can do any of this from the Calendar app, but I can’t just hand write things into a planner. I purchased this thinking I could just write on the planner like I would a normal paper seems pretty ridiculous to pay for something you already have native on your device

reviews.title: Irritated
reviews.text: I bought the lifetime subscription, deleted the app for a little while, logged back in and I cannot restore my purchase.  If it says lifetime, I expect lifetime!!

reviews.title: Developer more interested in FamCal
reviews.text: Developer updates FamCal more than Planner Pro. I feel like that is there main focus. Planner Pro could be great with a little tweaking and added features.

reviews.title: Do not purchase packages
reviews.text: I purchased the lifetime package and the app still displays the ads. I gave this two stars as I really like the usability of the digital planner, however, do not waste your time on purchasing the packages because they do not sync.

reviews.title: Premium user with serious synch/account issue and no resolution to date
reviews.text:
I’ve been a Premium Planner Pro user and rely on it daily, but I’m currently experiencing a major sync problem that has not been resolved.
My iPad contains all of my correct data, but my iPhone shows different information and will not sync. The web version will not recognize my account at all and returns errors saying the account does not exist or that the data is in the wrong format.
I contacted support and was told to download a “Planner Pro iPad app” on my computer, which does not exist, so I’m unable to follow their instructions. I have not received a meaningful solution since.
At this point, my data appears to exist on one device but is not accessible or syncing across others, which is very concerning for a planning app.
I would greatly appreciate someone from the team reviewing my account and providing clear steps to restore proper syncing and access.

reviews.title: Was great not now
reviews.text: Can’t sync apple calendars too Planner Pro anymore. No option to allow the access, subscription cancellation eminent

reviews.title: i hate the new version

reviews.title: No backup
reviews.text: My tablet had hard drive issue. It did not sync to  iCloud. Lost everything. Did not sync to other devices. Why pay?

reviews.title: It is not reliable
reviews.text:
Do yourself a favor and look for another platform. I have a very busy schedule and rely solely on a calendar app. I tried this one, created an account and even paid the premium membership. In two different occasions it deleted EVERYTHING with no explanation. I didn’t even sign out or did anything that would make the app reboot.

Probably an app for a school girl with no important tasks
